Sana - CSM: Heads-up — Coralworks signaled expansion today. They want to onboard 2 new teams (search + analytics) and start using embeddings for product search. Asked about timeline for next 4 weeks. :eyes:
Jonah - AE: Nice. Do we have any renewal trigger or is this pure expansion? (they're up for renewal in 3 months)
Sana - CSM: It's both. They said expansion will accelerate usage and would like a bundled plan discussion before renewal. Possible upsell if we can guarantee throughput.
Mike - Solutions: Can we get their current qps & token mix? Also which model family are they on for embeddings now?
Sana - CSM: Current: hosted API, ~60 RPS peak, ~1.6M tokens/day, embeddings via text-embedding-3-multilingual. Search team expects ~2x embeddings traffic; analytics will add streaming generation (mainly short answers).
Alyssa - Eng: For 2x embeddings + streaming, short-term we can absorb on hosted but latency may spike during peak. Recommend reserving a burst pool or moving embeddings to a Dedicated pod.
Mike - Solutions: Agreed. If they commit to a 6-month reserved tier for embeddings we can guarantee p50 latency <45ms and provide cost break.
Jonah - AE: I'll float a draft commitment to the customer. Can we get an estimated delta in monthly cost for Dedicated vs hosted for their forecast?
Mike - Solutions: Give me 24 hrs — I'll run numbers with the optimizer. Also tagging capacity-bot to check GPU availability in their preferred region (us-west2).
capacity-bot: Capacity check queued. Estimated available dedicated slots next 7 days: 2 pods (A100), 1 pod (T4) — more available within 30 days.
Alyssa - Eng: One more note — analytics team wants dataset privacy and audit logs. Private deployment isn't necessary yet but we should surface KMS/HSM options in the proposal.
Sana - CSM: Great. Action items: @Jonah draft upsell ask + timeline; @Mike deliver cost delta & perf guarantees by EOD tomorrow; @Alyssa prepare short note on audit/KMS options for the proposal. I'll schedule an internal enablement call with onboarding and Eng next Wed.
Jonah - AE: On it. Also I'll flag renewal conversation to our renewals lead to align timing.
Sana - CSM: Thanks team — Coralworks is healthy but this expansion makes renewal a near-term opportunity. Quick wins: capacity + cost proposal should close this.
Mike - Solutions: Happy path looks promising. If we need temporary burst before Dedicated, we can enable autoscaling + prefix caching to smooth p99s.
Alyssa - Eng: I'll loop in infra docs and a short runbook for onboarding the additional teams.
Sana - CSM: Perfect. Will update thread after internal sync. :thumbsup:
